measures.what: Please report the tripod/head brand and model, the camera model (and lens), and whether the missing piece slides into angled rails or drops into a recess with a locking lever. If possible, measure the receiving opening's length and width in mm. Don't include the tripod's pan/tilt controls.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: 38 mm alone doesn't identify the locking shape. Does it have two opposing angled jaws tightened by a screw (Arca-style), or a shaped recess with a snap lever? Please measure the jaw contact height, the opening width at the bottom and top of those jaws when set to grip a 38 mm plate, and usable length along the slide direction. Report the brand/model if visible. If you cannot measure the angles/profile, please say so.
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.item: clamp, camera socket, and available salvaged webcam-mount bolt
measures.what: Please measure what you can: (1) clamp lip contact height and angled jaw profile—bottom and top opening widths at the same knob setting; (2) camera socket usable depth, gently using a nonmetal probe with the camera off, without forcing anything; (3) salvaged 1/4-20 bolt length from under its head to tip, threaded length, head diameter and head thickness, including any fixed knob or shoulder. Do you have that bolt, and can its head be turned with a tool? Also report camera/lens weight if known. Say 'can't measure' for anything unavailable.
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head); tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.item: tripod jaw profile and camera socket
measures.what: Two safety-critical measurements are still missing. Can you measure the angled jaw contact height and the opening widths at its bottom and top, at one unchanged knob setting? Can you measure safe usable camera-thread depth and confirm the 10 mm bolt is threaded all the way up to its head? If any cannot be measured, explicitly say so. Without these I can only supply an unloaded fit-test plate, not a camera-ready replacement.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)
